name: drrcp-monorepo
description: Disaster Relief & Rescue Coordination Platform (DRRCP) — monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend
